report.no_suspects: No app crashes observed up to then.
report.app_crashed: __app__ crashed __n__ time(s) since the previous check, __total__ in the last 24 h.
report.daily_title: Daily health check – Homey __version__, up since __since__ (reason: __reason__).
report.memory_before: Memory at the previous check: PSS __pss__.
report.killed_hint: No error message – Homey may have stopped the app, e.g. for too much memory.
report.daily_memory: Memory: __n__ app(s) above Athom's 30 MB PSS guideline. Largest: __list__.
report.daily_no_crashes: No app crashes in the last 24 h.
report.last_check: Last check before the restart: __time__ (__gap__ before).
report.pm_unavailable: No Insights data for the time before the restart.
report.pm_none: Insights: no unusual RAM or CPU in __n__ apps during the __min__ min before the restart.
report.pm_ram_jump: RAM jump of __change__ MB in one minute
report.unplanned_7d: Unplanned restarts in the last 7 days: __n__.
report.daily_system: Homey: free memory __free__, swap __swap__, Homey core __core__.
report.pm_sys_jump: System memory rose __mb__ MB in one minute (__time__).
report.pm_sys_jump_not_apps: The apps did not grow in that minute (__apps__ MB together), so the rise came from outside them (Homey itself or a system process).
report.pm_sys_jump_outside: The apps grew __apps__ MB of that; about __rest__ MB came from outside them (Homey itself or a system process).
report.pm_sys_jump_apps: The apps account for that rise (__apps__ MB together).
report.pm_procs: Between the last two checks before the restart: __list__.
report.pm_together: __n__ apps changed in the same minute (__time__), which points at a system event rather than one app.
report.recurring_boot: Recurring: __n__ unplanned restarts around __time__ – may be caused by something scheduled.
report.recurring_crash: Recurring: __n__ app crashes around __time__ (__apps__) – may be caused by something scheduled.
report.crash_link: __app__ crashed within an hour before __n__ of __total__ unplanned restarts.
report.v_cause_homey: **Likely cause: Homey itself.** Nothing points at an app, power, heat or overload.
report.v_cause_unknown: **Cause unclear:** too little data for a verdict.
report.v_crashes_ok: App crashes: none in the 24 h before
report.v_crashes_bad: App crashes: __n__ in the 24 h before, most by __app__
report.v_apps_ok: Apps: none grew or loaded the CPU
report.v_apps_bad: Apps: __app__ grew or loaded the CPU
report.v_core_swap: swap __mb__ MB at the last check
report.v_advice_app: Advice: update, restart or disable __app__ and see if the restarts stop.
report.v_advice_power: Advice: check the power adapter and cable, preferably the one that came with Homey.
report.v_advice_heat: Advice: give Homey free air around it, away from sun and heat sources.
report.v_advice_load: Advice: look at heavy Flows and apps that ran just before.
report.v_advice_homey: Advice: create a diagnostics report in the Homey app (Settings → General) and contact Athom support with the time above.
report.v_advice_unknown: Advice: wait for the next restart; it gives a better picture.
